newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Adria passenger numbers up nine pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Adria passenger numbers up nine pct in '96.

text.p: Slovenia's lone airline Adria Airways said on Wednesday passenger numbers rose nine percent in 1996, helped by economic growth and an increase in tourism.
"There are many reasons for that increase. Probably the main ones are the growth of Slovenia's economy and an increase in tourism," Adria Airways spokesman Ljerka Zupancic told Reuters.
Over 594,000 passengers flew on 10,236 Adria flights in 1996. One third of all flights were chartered.
Zupancic said the airline was aiming for a five percent increase in passenger numbers this year.
Cargo volume, excluding trucking, decreased by two percent in 1996 to 3,785 tonnes. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
